# Development Guidelines

## Code Standards
- Use snake_case for functions and variables
- Include type hints for all public function signatures
- Raise ValueError for invalid inputs, not generic Exception

## Pre-commit Hooks
This project enforces code quality via pre-commit. Before committing:
```bash
pip install pre-commit && pre-commit run --all-files --verbose
```
Always use --verbose so hook output is printed to the job logs for debugging.
All hooks must pass before changes are committed. This applies to both
manual commits and automated tooling.

## Lint Baseline Data
The `.lint-results/` directory contains lint baseline data generated by the
pre-commit hooks. These files MUST be committed and preserved in every PR.
They are used by CI to track lint regressions across commits. Do NOT delete,
remove, or git-rm any files in `.lint-results/`. If pre-commit hooks generate
or update files in this directory, stage and commit them along with your
other changes. Removing these files will cause CI lint-regression checks to
fail on the target branch.

## Testing
- Use pytest for all tests
- Test edge cases: zero, negative numbers, very large values
- Run tests with: python -m pytest tests/ -v
